matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Seafarers Charter standards and employer responsibilities for seafarers working on relevant maritime services.
Discover UK employment guidance for Seafarers Charter. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
Employers must protect their seafarers’ health by:

providing immunisations for certain infectious diseases

making sure hygiene measures are effective and minimise the risks of infection

making arrangements for infection control

having the right medical supplies

knowing the routes and destinations of their ships

Read the guidance on infectious disease at sea.

Read the guidance on contamination of ships’ air conditioning systems by legionella.

You can buy the Ship Captain’s Medical Guide through The Stationery Office Shop website.

Until the UK made the Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) law, seafarers’ health and safety regulations were covered by the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.
